params.note: total land fixed; K only splits it among independent employers

growth g raises potential output by g per year in every growing scenario; 'entry' delivers it as new independent employers, 'incumbent' as bigger existing employers. In the main runs moving cost and home production scale with potential output (pure test of plurality); the 'absolute_costs' runs hold them fixed. Every year each owner is bought out with probability 'merge' by a size-weighted acquirer, preferring nearby targets.

params.serf_role: competitive marginal product 1.3 x subsistence, irreplaceable (rho=0)
params.sally_role: competitive marginal product 4 x subsistence, 95% replaceable (rho=0.95)

params.cost_of_striking: tau x one year's individual wage x lognormal(sd 0.5) + repression; main tau=0.25

part5_collective_action.note: with no private reward, if nobody expects a strike, nobody strikes at any group size (success 0)
